Every alternative shortfall basis (spur 6.350, rounded trip_record 20.6) also gives 4.80, so the amount is robust. POL-GEN-05: 4.80 <= 8.00. No referral (RD-06 not engaged; RD-09(3) no ERP; no RD-09(4) phantom line). Possible competing readings considered and rejected: NO_ACTION via RD-01's 'no deviation exists' (that sentence concerns the rider's deviation claim; the compensation limb is expressly separate and RD-11 routes to it); NO_ACTION via 'may be granted' (RD-11's 'it is compensated under POL-RD-04 instead' is directive and both readers read it so); compensation for the 6-minute wait (no route-deviation clause pays mid-trip waiting; inventing one would breach POL-GEN-07). None gives a second defensible answer on this record, so no case fix is needed. Difficulty HARD is a defensible design label for this multi-clause chain and is kept. Verdict AGREE.
